Game Overview

Numeral Crawl is a math title where embark on a numerical survival journey in Numeral Crawl. Guide a serpentine string of numbered beads through treacherous obstacles, each collision costing vital beads. Strategize your moves and collect extras to strengthen your snake. Push your limits and see how far you can inch towards victory!
